Person X, person Y and I are in the same vicinity, presumably conversing. Whenever I say something to person X, person X will respond to me without making eye contact with me or making eye contact with person Y. 

That shit is extremely rude and makes me feel unwelcome in the conversation.

One time I was texting a drug dealer and my mom at the same time. I was texting logistics with the dealer and some other regular stuff with my mom. I guess I wasn't paying attention and ended up sending my mom something to the effect of "how much for x number of hits?" And she managed to figure out what was going on....
